description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Digsite Conservator, adding {C}{C}.
When Digsite Conservator dies, it, Mortuary and Pawn of Ulamog trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Digsite Conservator on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Digsite Conservator trigger, causing you to pay {4} to exile Digsite Conservator from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
